omnicard.longDescription: Omnicard is an ambitious personal project focused on building a complete strategic card game, with a dedicated business engine, complex rule logic and an architecture built to last. The project lets me work on domain modeling, effect management, real-time synchronization, and the integration between a structured back-end and a modern interface.

gup.shortDescription: One CLI to scan and update everything installed on a dev machine — 130+ package managers.
gup.longDescription: gup (Global Updater) is a command-line tool that unifies software updates on a machine by aggregating 130+ sources: winget, scoop, choco, npm, pnpm, yarn, bun, pip, pipx, uv, cargo, gem, dotnet tools, helm, kubectl, terraform, VSCode/JetBrains extensions, WSL distributions and many more. It tackles package-manager fragmentation with a single interface, an interactive selection mode, a fast scan, JSON output for CI/CD scripting and a doctor command to detect installed providers. Security is handled in depth: shell-less execution via execa (argv vector), HTTPS-only, CodeQL/Semgrep/gitleaks static analysis and automated dependency auditing.
gup.highlights.0: Single update interface for 130+ providers (winget, npm, cargo, pip, kubectl…)
gup.highlights.1: Interactive mode, fast scan, JSON output and a doctor detection command
gup.highlights.2: Defense-in-depth security: shell-less execa, HTTPS-only, CodeQL/Semgrep/gitleaks
gup.lessonsLearned.0: Designing a common abstraction over dozens of heterogeneous package managers
gup.lessonsLearned.1: Industrializing a testable, scriptable CLI built for CI/CD
gup.lessonsLearned.2: Applying a defense-in-depth security approach to a system tool
img-convertor.shortDescription: Fast image converter and responsive breakpoint resizer for the web — WebP, AVIF, JPEG, PNG, CLI or interactive mode.
img-convertor.longDescription: img-convertor is a command-line tool for web asset preparation: conversion between WebP, AVIF, JPEG and PNG, plus responsive variant generation at breakpoint widths while preserving aspect ratio. It offers both a polished CLI and a guided interactive console, recursive directory processing, named breakpoint presets and persistent configuration (~/.img-convertor/config.json). The architecture separates reusable pure logic (core/) from UI layers, enabling both programmatic and standalone usage. It relies on sharp for encoding, Commander for the CLI and Inquirer for the interactive prompts, with 100% test coverage and a multi-OS GitHub Actions CI.
img-convertor.highlights.0: WebP / AVIF / JPEG / PNG conversion and responsive breakpoint resizing
img-convertor.highlights.1: Polished CLI + interactive console, recursive processing and configurable presets
img-convertor.highlights.2: Pure core/ architecture decoupled from the UI, 100% test coverage
img-convertor.lessonsLearned.0: Decoupling pure business logic from CLI and interactive interfaces
img-convertor.lessonsLearned.1: Tooling end-to-end responsive web asset preparation
img-convertor.lessonsLearned.2: Maintaining exhaustive test coverage on an image-processing tool
